description: This file defines a command for deleting a comment in a web application, including validation and the request handler that interacts with the database to remove the comment based on article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the Command, CommandValidator, and QueryHandler for deleting a comment.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a comment based on the provided article slug and comment ID, performing database lookups and removal.
